name: fantom-lsp
description: Language server protocol support for the Fantom programming language

fantom.home.description: Path to Fantom installation directory (FAN_HOME). If empty, the extension will check the FAN_HOME environment variable and PATH.

fantom.envPath.description: Absolute Fantom environment root directories containing lib/fan pods (relative paths are ignored). Used only for file-backed workspace lookup, together with current workspace auto-detection, never added to JVM FAN_ENV_PATH. Changes apply to server lookups immediately.

fantom.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Fantom language server.

fantom.javaOpts.description: JVM options passed to the Fantom language server (e.g. -Xmx2048m for more memory).

fantom.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of .fan files to index. 0 means no limit (use fantom.javaOpts heap for large trees).

fantom.codeLens.enabled.description: Show reference-count code lenses on Fantom methods, constructors, and fields. Click a count to show references.

fantom.semanticIndex.backgroundCompile.description: Compile workspace pods in the background for precise symbol resolution and reference counts. Incomplete counts are marked with +.

fantom.excludeDirs.description: Directory names to skip when indexing workspace sources. Default includes lib (installed pods).

enumDescriptions: Allman style - braces on new line (e.g., class Foo\n{)
K&R style - braces on same line (e.g., class Foo {)
fantom.formatting.bracketStyle.description: Bracket style to use when formatting code.
